corpus: Original FLORES-200 dev and devtest; all aligned sentences, no selection by scores
license: FLORES-200 CC BY-SA 4.0. Source translations redistributed unchanged. Derived statistics and article CC BY-SA 4.0.
target: Existing rune-only joined LP2-00–55 token ledger, 2896 tokens, headings included; no decimal tokens.
models: letters: NFC lower-case alphabetic codepoints; internal straight/curly apostrophes removed, other nonletters separate words
folded: NFD remove combining marks, then same tokenizer

gp-length: folded words greedily collapse ING, TH, EO, NG, OE, AE, IA, IO, EA; aliases ING/NG, IO/IA, K/C, Z/S share symbols; other letters retained. Orthographic sensitivity, NOT validated phonetic GP transcription.
welsh-digraph: Welsh only, NFC letters; greedy CH DD FF NG LL PH RH TH as units; mechanical digraph sensitivity, not morphological parsing
primary_metric: Total variation distance between word-length histograms, bins 1..15 and16+. Lower is closer. Rank eight languages separately for each of first three representations. Never combine metrics into a language probability.
secondary_metrics: IoC and within-word adjacent-identical fraction; separate distances under fixed bijective substitution only. Distinct symbol inventory reported.
controls: Dev language profiles classify each whole devtest language by word-length distance (8 held-out documents per representation). No tuning after scoring.
uncertainty: 200 seeded paired bootstrap draws of source-article URL clusters within devtest, all sentences of sampled articles retained. Same article draw across languages. Target fixed. Report distance percentile range and best-rank frequency; these are corpus sampling sensitivity, not language probabilities. Seed3301.
exclusions: No decryption; no claim one global cipher/language; no posterior; no all-language coverage; no genre-matched medieval/philosophical corpus; no unknown phonetic conversion; no unspaced languages or mixed plaintext inference.
